name: semget
synopsis: int semget(key_t key, int nsems, int semflg);
description: The semget() system call returns the System V semaphore set identifier associated with the argument key. It is used to obtain the identifier of a previously created semaphore set or to create a new set with the specified number of semaphores if flags allow.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key used to identify or create the semaphore set.

parameters.name: nsems
parameters.description: Number of semaphores in the set; must be greater than 0 when creating, or 0 for existing sets.

parameters.name: semflg
parameters.description: Flags for creation options (e.g., IPC_CREAT, IPC_EXCL) and permissions.

return_value.success: Returns the semaphore set identifier (a nonnegative integer)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno on error

errors.description: Semaphore set exists but the calling process lacks permission to access it.
IPC_CREAT and IPC_EXCL were specified, but a semaphore set already exists for the key.
nsems is less than 0 or greater than the limit on semaphores per set (SEMMSL).
A semaphore set exists for the key, but nsems is larger than the number of semaphores in that set.
No semaphore set exists for the key and IPC_CREAT was not specified.
Insufficient memory to create a new semaphore set.
System limit for semaphore sets (SEMMNI) or total semaphores (SEMMNS) would be exceeded.

bugs: The name choice IPC_PRIVATE was perhaps unfortunate; IPC_NEW would more clearly show its function.
